copy.heading: Current-state assessment
copy.instructions: Award yourself one point for each statement that is true. Lauren will check your answers, and Priya has asked for a copy.

items: You have told someone that padel is the fastest-growing sport in the world, and they had not asked what the fastest-growing sport in the world was.
You answered the 6am group chat before you answered the baby.
The racket bag is in the car boot, and the buggy is not.
You moved Mia's swimming lesson so you could keep your Saturday 9am court.
You have worn a padel quarter-zip to a client lunch and described it as "smart casual".
You have tried to get your father-in-law into padel. He is seventy-one and has a new hip.
You have proposed padel as the team social three quarters running, and lost the vote to bowling each time.
You have shown someone your smartwatch graphs from Tuesday night's doubles, and they were not your doubles partner.
You have described tennis as "basically padel without the walls" to a person holding a tennis racket.
You are reading this list and working out how to explain that number 9 is technically true.
